definition: to have enough money for something
description: In an elegant restaurant in the evening, with chandeliers, candles, white tablecloths and tall arched windows over a river, a young woman in a green silk dress looks down into her open brown wallet with a nervous smile. A man in a velvet jacket points happily at the menu while a waiter pours champagne. She closes the wallet in her lap and looks up as a waiter brings a tall three-level tray of lobster, crabs and oysters to the table, and she smiles. A violinist plays behind them.
